completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Action,one perceived creature60feet,4d8necrotic per round and heal half. NEW reconcile Core Instantaneous with a concentration channel lasting at most60seconds, with one initial pulse during the casting Action and at most nine further pulses, never more than ten total. The initial pulse makes a ranged spell attack against the declared creature using the real casting source; hit deals4d8necrotic (ordinary attack critical applies), miss deals none. Only one original target exists; no retarget. At each future regular caster turn an Action may maintain one further pulse against that same still-existing original creature target, with perception/range60/line of effect rechecked. At most one pulse per original regular caster-turn cycle; extra turns/Actions grant none. If no maintenance Action is completed during an available future regular turn, the channel ends at that turn's END; a miss still counts as maintenance. Outside initiative an otherwise capable caster spends the equivalent whole Action at each successive six-second cycle; missed maintenance ends it. Loss of concentration, actual caster incapacity, target death, actual separation beyond60feet, loss of line of effect/perception, removal or expiry ends the channel immediately; suppression makes a pulse unavailable, consumes its scheduled opportunity and therefore causes missed-maintenance ending if it spans the entire relevant turn/cycle. No paused beam or stored future pulse exists. A hit's healing resolves after its damage/life consequences, even if that hit killed the target and thereby ended later pulses: caster receives ordinary base healing floor(actualDamageDealt/2), using this pulse's eligible terminal branches once and excluding duplicated parents, overkill and copied/replayed descendants. Do not halve nominal dice before counting actual damage or require ordinary HP loss when tempHP was truly absorbed. Damage transfer remains one root; sum its actual terminal recipients without healing separately for each. Apply genuine ordinary healing modifiers, broad prohibition, current maximum/Critical ceiling and source causal guards. Full casterHP, blocked healing or a miss stores nothing and refunds nothing. Unlike Lifedraw's expressly narrower profile, this proposal adds no living-nonconstruct/allied/helpless exclusion to the printed damage and heal clause; necrotic defenses still govern actual numbers. Damage/HP cannot be farmed from an invented summon resource pool or overkill. A subsequent paid cast begins a genuinely new channel and concentration, not a free same-channel extra pulse; all real Action/RP/Dissonance costs apply. The proposal's ten-pulse ceiling and continuous maintenance are NEW balance choices for joint review.

CURRENT HEALING-ELIGIBILITY COMPLETION: Exclude any terminal branch whose actual transfer/source flags forbid derived healing or recovery before summing the base-healing pool. The original NE5-06-B arithmetic is conditional on a genuinely permitted split, not a claim that Burden Shared or Life Linked allows it. The two supplied source-qualified vectors show their actual narrower results and retain the original abstract scenario unchanged. Neither vector changes the separate pending broad donor predicate for this spell.

CURRENT TARGET-CONTINUITY COMPLETION — Enervation only: "Still-existing original creature" is the target identity/lifecycle predicate, not a new living-anatomy or nonconstruct restriction. A continuing active creature classified as nonliving is not excluded solely by that classification. Its actual defenses, damage/source eligibility and no-resource/no-recovery flags still apply to each packet and any healing funding. A corpse, removed body, ended summon or destroyed entity that no longer qualifies as a creature cannot supply a maintained target. A same identity at 0 HP is tested under its actual continuing-creature/Disabled/death state, not assumed dead or alive from the HP number. The attack that actually ends the target finishes its own causal damage and source-qualified healing before future channel opportunities are canceled. This completion does not import Leeching Plague's hostile-living-nonconstruct donor filter, provide healing to a dead caster, or grant repair, resurrection, resource farming or an exception to another source's exclusion flags.

CL10-CAST-01.classification: INHERITED interfaces with explicitly identified spell-local completions
CL10-CAST-01.scope: These ten ordinary spells; no source/catalog rewrite
CL10-CAST-01.completeText:
Keep each complete current source/access object and every original Core/catalog entry unchanged. The catalog's actual class-school placement, rank and minimum class level must be paired with a real learned/prepared repertoire. A source-only access row does not supply the rest of an unsupplied class engine. No union of another class's schools is allowed. Universal Create Homunculus remains Universal; Necromancy remains Necromancy. No named material, blood, corpse, gem or monetary component is inferred from a title. Golem and Danse retain V/S/M-F evidence; the inherited focus alternative is usable without inventing consumed materials.

All ten have an Action casting time and printed 60-foot range. Preserve that range as evidence even where Soulburn's proposed self-only recovery narrows its operation. Base RP is 7 at rank 4, 10 at rank 5 and 13 at rank 6. Apply only actual accepted price rules and acquired class exceptions. Quote and pay before ordinary counter/interrupt resolution; a future recovered pool cannot fund that quotation. Source-specific HP costs are real normal-HP costs, not damage, healing, temporary HP or a shareable packet. They cannot lower the payer below 1 HP. Countered or paid hidden-ineligible outcomes do not refund HP/RP or restore displaced concentration.

Use the accepted spell-commitment, Dissonance/Refrain and Ready rules, not a generic new sequence. The acquired Wizard matrix exception can change base Dissonance; it does not erase Refrain. Idle turns do not reset either. A readied spell pays/prepares and begins held concentration at preparation; its legal target/area is selected and checked at release. The particular effect's lifetime begins only at successful release/establishment. A separately source-authorized nonspell Action repair/readied technique has its own payment at actual execution, not an invented spell cast.

NEW spell-local durations retained for authoring: Corpse Golem, Death Knight and Soul Wraith require concentration and end 60 actual seconds after establishment. Flood/Danse animation bodies end 3,600 actual seconds after their successful formation and require no concentration. Their printed Instantaneous metadata describes establishment, not a rewrite of the original. Create Undead's physical conversion is permanent; its separate rank-six authority relation and Command Undeath last until their real removal. Homunculus's created body/control is persistent with the distinct endings stated below. Soulburn and Grave Gift resolve instantaneous components and create no upkeep duration. An outside-mode six-second cycle is a clock mapping, never an extra action. Absolute deadlines, true regular owner markers, body-source expiry and already-spent command resources never reset on suppression, healing, release, renaming or mode changes.

CL10-COMMAND-01.scope: Golem, Knight, Wraith, Flood/Danse zombies, Create Undead and Homunculus only
CL10-COMMAND-01.completeText:
Keep original creator, current controller, body identity and source application as distinct records. Original creator-derived spell attacks, DCs and saves use the actual original creating class record; a temporary controller does not lend a better casting modifier. A profile that says PB as the total save bonus does not also add its ability modifier. Profile attacks add no ability damage unless that particular attack prints it. Critical hits double eligible attack dice, not flat modifiers or a later independent saving-throw aura.

The acquired Wizard Conjuration creation bonus is tested against an actual creature created by that Wizard's spell, not against the creating spell's school label alone. Snapshot its +Wizard-level maximum HP at genuine qualifying creation. The separately acquired Flesh Ascendant bonus is the current eligible controlling Wizard's +2 per Wizard level where its actual controlled-Undead predicate passes. Preserve the accepted exception that permits those two distinct bonuses together and the single strongest eligible application of each named source; no alias duplication. Later maximum-HP changes use the accepted clamp/capacity rules and do not themselves heal. If the source-owner later dies, its extant class/stat record does not become zero or a different controller's statistics.

While creator-controlled, each capable named asset resolves only in the actual attached phase after the whole owner's regular turn. A paid Bonus Action on that regular turn directs at most one eligible asset. It uses the accepted owner-wide one-command allowance and, for offense, the one-offensive-asset allowance for that numbered round across pets, minions, devices and these spells. Do not grant an independent Reaction, an extra owner turn, a second command during an extra Action or a second offensive asset because spell/class asset caps differ. The commanded asset must satisfy its own position, perception, path and resource prerequisites when it resolves. An issued command is not refunded or replayed if that phase lacks a legal action. Lack of a valid command permits only the source's actual defensive movement/Dodge, not an attack, skilled task or resource use.

NEW source limits: one Corpse Golem, one Death Knight, one Soul Wraith and one Homunculus per original caster; one Flood body; one Danse cohort containing at most five; two Create Undead authority slots. These are separate from Wizard's three standard-minion slots, Ranger Beast, Mage elite slots, Mirror assets and the existing Expedition roster. They do not multiply the shared command/offense allowances. A successful replacement ends/replaces only that spell's indicated source/body/control record. A known cap replacement must be declared before commitment; a failed new establishment never selects a substitute, but starting new concentration has already ended an incompatible prior concentration.

Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus may use a genuine still-available creation-turn Bonus Action command and subsequent real attached phase; creation itself supplies no attack/task. NEW Flood, Danse and Create Undead forbid all voluntary acts in the numbered round of creation, including a bonus Dodge; outside initiative their first possible phase is the next genuine six-second cycle. The actual source lifespan starts at formation even while this prohibition applies. Creator incapacity alone does not retroactively cancel an already valid nonconcentration order; actual concentration ending or source/body loss does. An absent original owner supplies no fictitious attached phase. Command Undeath and release of a permanent Create Undead body use CL10-ORDER-01, not an invented owner-turn refresh.

CL10-BODY-01.title: Bodies, geometry, stock and incomplete facts
CL10-BODY-01.classification: INHERITED body/gear rules; explicit scope boundaries
CL10-BODY-01.scope: Only the named authored bodies; not a world physiology or environment engine
CL10-BODY-01.completeText:
Use Tiny 2.5-by-2.5-foot, Small/Medium 5-by-5-foot and Large 10-by-10-foot occupied horizontal spaces under the accepted body rule. A source body's measured height, current orientation, actual missing parts, body mass and supports are separate facts. No named class or ordinary Small/Medium Beast gets a two-foot combat body from [1,1,1]. A new scenario must print its actual body extents; numeric damage-only examples do not prove range, cone, collision, reach or close-quarters eligibility.

A created body's initial space must already fit, be unoccupied, be perceived/targetable within the source's real range and have the source-required support before casting. No future growth or creation expands the world to legalize a target. A corpse conversion occurs at its same actual physical anchor using current matter, not a free relocation to a convenient empty square. Voluntary size changes obey actual preflight. Mandatory source ending, death, reversion, body removal and release of melded cargo always happen; no body-reservation ward or whole external-event veto is created. Where this proposal explicitly calls canonical normalization, use same anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent space in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie, with no farther search or wall/occupant passage. Normalization spends no movement and creates no opportunity/charge/movement rider. Banishment's separately named conflict semantics are not imported.

All carried/worn items are real separate IDs. Apply actual physical-capacity AND Load limits, hand/slot/fit restrictions and Burdened penalties. A listed local smaller cargo limit adds a restriction; it does not cancel weight or Load. Genuine body parcels count as bodies under their source, never bundled equipment. Created intrinsic swords/wrappings/appearance have no independent harvestable stock. On actual body ending, real gear uses current-position legal item placement, nearest legal adjacent item placement or pending-placement state. No item jumps to a distant historical last-open square, and disappearance never recreates old cargo, repairs its condition or refills fuel.

Corpse-derived animations retain one consumed physical allocation, original body history, missing limbs, harvested parts, real gear and documented physiological/terrain requirements. Their fresh listed base HP is a new animation HP pool, not limb repair, Wound treatment, resurrection or corpse replenishment. No-breath/no-food/no-water/no-sleep, immunity, natural origin and soul status cannot be inferred from the Undead/Construct label. A permanent-body work/exposure scenario must bind the actual retained needs and applicable recovery rules; an unavailable need/profile fact remains an explicit input prerequisite, not an immunity. This conference gives no global corpse-decay or living-physiology engine. The newly generated finite manifestations and Homunculus likewise gain only their stated traits; source-dependent environmental use needs the actual required trait record.

Command Undeath's required CR is an authoritative mechanical profile field, not an appearance check or a derived result from these new HP values. All four Create Undead alternatives remain unrated. The complete frozen bestiary is a source-only record collection; no exact operative CR2 Undead is supplied. A positive Command fixture therefore remains conditional until a complete individually authorized eligible profile is bound.

CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.title: Damage roots, disabled bodies and valid healing
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.classification: INHERITED root/life order plus NEW limited animation lifecycle binding
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.scope: The seven created/animated-body spells here; no universal Undead healing grant
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.completeText:
A creature attack creates its damage root at the actual accepted damage checkpoint, with that acting companion as dealer and the original creator retained separately as stat/source owner. Creator Veil does not automatically make a Golem/Knight/Wraith/zombie attack Null. Flood's ordinary spell packet has its caster as dealer. Separate attack events create separate roots; child packets inherit their parent flag; sharing preserves flags and never double-counts the parent and terminal branches. Apply the actual real damage, prevention, temporary HP, Wound/death and actual immediate-response sequence. Do not decide actual death just from reaching zero.

Qualifying Null damage uses the accepted ordered protection, including damage-caused Instant Death/Wound/Maiming/fatal-Wound exclusions and retained prior zero-state histories. It is not an HP-cost prevention, independent expiry immunity, resurrection or concentration immunity. Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus bind their existing finite-created/Construct recipient branches: a qualifying Null packet taking the surviving body to zero, or hitting the same already-disabled body, records/preserves NullDisabled0 rather than ordinary damage-caused disappearance. This adds no living-ally target predicate, Wounds, death saves, Stable roll or rest regeneration to these HP-only profiles. Their own concentration, expiry, dismissal, replacement and suppression endings still happen.

NEW named extension: Flood zombies, Danse zombies and the four Create Undead bodies use the same finite or persistent consumed-animation principle for qualifying Null damage: preserve the same body/allocation, authority, HP0, gear and clocks in NullDisabled0; no fresh corpse destruction or resource trigger. This specifically binds these new profiles and does not relabel them as Wizard standard minions. Further qualifying Null damage neither destroys nor refreshes them. Independent authority/source ending, genuine non-Null damage causing the profile's ordinary zero/destroyed branch, or another actually applicable real ending remains effective. A living target of Flood instead uses its own real living/death-save/Beast lifecycle; Null preventing its death prevents Flood's zombie claim.

Legal positive restoration to the same extant disabled body clears only that zero-HP disabled state. It never refills a command, lifespan, ability, limb or inventory. Homunculus's explicit maintenance and Wraith's own self-lifetap are named permissions. Any other proposed repair/heal must supply an actual eligible target source. Cleric Healing Rite requires a living ally, and the scoped AC4/AC5/AC6 living-ally extensions do not include these new bodies. This conference does not extend that predicate. A source with its own creature-only healing permission can be evaluated on its actual terms; Undead/Construct alone supplies neither immunity nor universal eligibility.

CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.title: Distinct suppression and terminal identity
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.classification: NEW source-local lifecycle choices constrained by accepted antimagic and life rules
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.scope: Only these named applications under the actual suppressing source; not a global field-size rule
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.completeText:
Do not unify the bodies merely because they are summons. A full operational body-expression suppression ends Corpse Golem, Soul Wraith and Homunculus immediately with current-position real cargo settlement and no stored return. For Golem/Wraith this also ends that now-empty creating application; it does not resume when the field ends. A narrower suppressed attack/rider suppresses only its own expression unless the actual field also suppresses the body sustaining expression.

Death Knight instead temporarily has no expressed body. Record its actual current pose when suppression starts, same identity/HP/NullDisabled state/current maximum/source owner/spent allowances and absolute deadline. Real external gear drops there under existing item placement, and intrinsic shadow equipment produces nothing. The absent body provides no occupancy, cover, support, attack or sensory presence. When all applicable suppressors end while the source remains live, attempt to re-express that same body at the saved pose using the local canonical fitting procedure. An occupied saved pose is not a protected berth. If no local placement is legal, expression remains pending within the original source lifetime; no extra duration is granted. Re-expression does not automatically reclaim dropped gear. A suppressed field can still contain the pending pose; it cannot resume merely by asking for an outside square. If source/clock ends first, nothing is re-created. A legal unsupported re-expression starts the actual Falling rules.

Flood and Danse keep their actual consumed physical bodies and real carried gear in place while their sustaining animation is suppressed. Suppressed animation supplies no voluntary movement, offense or command execution; gravity, ordinary collision/support, externally inflicted effects and absolute clocks remain real. Their eventual hour/zero/dispel/dismissal ending leaves the same consumed remains, not a fresh corpse. Create Undead is different again: permanent physical conversion is not undone by dispelling/suppressing its separate authority relation. Suppression of authority restores the body's underlying real independent agency; it does not grant an extra opportunity or free loyalty. Any independently magical native action/rider remains subject to the actual field on its own terms. Command Undeath similarly suppresses control, not an existing body's physical existence.

NEW limited geometric completion: when accepted Lesser Antimagic intersects any part of the actual expressed body of Golem, Knight, Wraith, Homunculus, Flood zombie or Danse zombie, treat that named body's sustaining expression as fully suppressed for the lifecycle above. This extends no other spell or field and grants no immunity to merely partial-body intersections. For a temporarily absent Knight test the saved expression volume. Local suppression of Create Undead/Command Undeath authority is tested at the actual bound body's volume; it changes authority, not permanent flesh. These specific choices are proposed here, not inherited globally from the two AC5 or three AC6 families. Use their actual source family exception and spell-disruption rules without editing accepted AC5/AC6.

A suppressed queued command is spent/lost at its one genuine opportunity, not banked for resumption. Source expiry, real body death/removal and mandatory form endings are never vetoed by suppression. Direct removal uses the actual class/ordinary Dispel rank/cost/check and immutable operation rules. A Wizard rank-three class Dispel is not an ordinary rank-three Dispel by name, and Greater Dispel does not replay a previously suppressed removal merely because a suppressing field was ended in the same captured operation set.

CL10-ORDER-01.title: Command Undeath and released permanent bodies
CL10-ORDER-01.classification: NEW Command-Undeath/Create-Undead-only schedule and agency completion
CL10-ORDER-01.scope: No extension of DE4 domination to other sources
CL10-ORDER-01.completeText:
Choose Q14 option B: an already independent bound creature keeps its actual pre-binding initiative position and regular opportunities. Do not migrate it to the binder's attached phase. An existing companion keeps its actual original owner's attached phase and all source-owner stats/slots. Binding, suppression, release, death of a controller and return from suppression do not create an immediate turn, refresh a used Action/Reaction, replay START/END hooks or reset a recharge. The exact actual owner or independent schedule must be bound before a current worked fixture can be claimed complete.

While Command Undeath is operative, its non-Charmed permanent restriction permits only defensive movement/Dodge without a valid command. On the binder's actual regular turn, a Bonus Action through the spell's 60-foot same-plane perceived/LoE command channel can queue one bounded order for one target's next actual future behavior opportunity. A turn already underway is not a future opportunity. The order expires at that single opportunity whether executed, suppressed, invalid, impossible or budget-starved, or at the binder's next regular START or issuance+6 actual seconds, whichever occurs first. The six-second cap is a NEW Command-Undeath-only absolute order expiry, not a new lifetime for the permanent relation. Only one pending order per binder-target exists; it cannot be banked through absence or suppression. Reaching a deadline that is also a possible execution point expires it first under the actual ordered phases. A successfully heard order does not create an ongoing remote channel: later plane separation can prevent new issue, not supply new knowledge or alter the already fixed instruction.

The issuing Bonus Action consumes the actual owner-wide command allowance of its issuance round. At execution the binder's owner-wide offensive allowance for that execution round must also be unused and is consumed once; a command that crosses a round boundary neither duplicates an offensive allowance nor refunds its prior command. For a source-owned companion, both binder's and original owner's structural allowance for that body/phase must be satisfied. Reuse an existing reservation only for the same body, same phase and same offensive opportunity; do not charge an unwilling owner a new Bonus Action or reserve another companion's attack. The absent original owner supplies no invented attached action phase. Resolve genuinely competing source-qualified directives under actual applicable ordering; this proposal does not grant authority to override another named source's explicit priority.

A valid instruction can use the body's actual movement and one ordinary Action, including a native inherent Multiattack only when the bound profile really has it. It does not force optional finite-resource powers, spellcasting, expended charges/recharges, new Bonus Actions/Reactions, secrets, prohibited oaths, item surrender or a suicide operation. Mandatory ordinary ammunition/material expenditure of an otherwise legal ordinary attack still needs the actual item; an instruction creates none. Type/obedience is not a source of private knowledge. Range and LoE for an executed attack are measured from the actual acting body, not the binder. No order changes donor or soul identity.

Suppressed Command control restores ordinary underlying agency at the same real scheduled opportunity; no instruction is performed while the control is suppressed and none replays later. When control resumes, restore the still-live relation and future defensive-only restriction without repeating its already-admitted hard-control save. Actual target death ends that relation; caster death alone does not, but a dead/absent/incapacitated binder cannot issue legal orders. The caster can release its own relation on its actual regular turn without an Action. It grants no automatic loyalty, hostility, faction membership or property ownership afterward.

For Create Undead only, losing/suppressing/replacing creator authority leaves the permanent actual body alive in its current animation state. On first independent agency, preserve that numbered round's spent opportunity and creation-round prohibition. Do not give an immediate action: place its next independent regular slot immediately after its former creator slot at that slot's next scheduled occurrence, using stable body-ID order for a group. If an old slot cannot recur because the owner has left the encounter, retain its captured virtual slot solely as a scheduling marker and assign an independent slot at the next actual encounter scheduling boundary; no retroactive turn is invented. Restoring authority retires that independent slot only prospectively into the creator's next genuinely available attached phase; at most one voluntary opportunity per round survives the transition. This is a NEW limited transition rule for these permanently created profiles, not a global controller/initiative rewrite.

Released bodies need actual NPC behavior/needs/context records before a autonomous-work/combat sequence can be claimed complete. Release is not a direction to attack, obey forever, donate HP, take a crew job or harvest another corpse. Two authority slots are not a world population cap. Repeated genuinely paid Create Undead casts with different eligible real corpses may accumulate independent bodies over time; no automatic service, material reward or free roster space follows.

Outside initiative, a released permanent body uses independent successive six-second opportunities beginning no earlier than its next unspent former cycle boundary; re-entering initiative maps that pending opportunity without replay or refresh. This defines timing only. It supplies no unreviewed NPC goal, ability, reaction budget, physiology or work permission.

CL10-CAST-01.title: Source identity, access, costs and real clocks
CL10-CAST-01.classification: INHERITED interfaces with explicitly identified spell-local completions
CL10-CAST-01.scope: These ten ordinary spells; no source/catalog rewrite
CL10-CAST-01.completeText:
Keep each complete current source/access object and every original Core/catalog entry unchanged. The catalog's actual class-school placement, rank and minimum class level must be paired with a real learned/prepared repertoire. A source-only access row does not supply the rest of an unsupplied class engine. No union of another class's schools is allowed. Universal Create Homunculus remains Universal; Necromancy remains Necromancy. No named material, blood, corpse, gem or monetary component is inferred from a title. Golem and Danse retain V/S/M-F evidence; the inherited focus alternative is usable without inventing consumed materials.

All ten have an Action casting time and printed 60-foot range. Preserve that range as evidence even where Soulburn's proposed self-only recovery narrows its operation. Base RP is 7 at rank 4, 10 at rank 5 and 13 at rank 6. Apply only actual accepted price rules and acquired class exceptions. Quote and pay before ordinary counter/interrupt resolution; a future recovered pool cannot fund that quotation. Source-specific HP costs are real normal-HP costs, not damage, healing, temporary HP or a shareable packet. They cannot lower the payer below 1 HP. Countered or paid hidden-ineligible outcomes do not refund HP/RP or restore displaced concentration.

Use the accepted spell-commitment, Dissonance/Refrain and Ready rules, not a generic new sequence. The acquired Wizard matrix exception can change base Dissonance; it does not erase Refrain. Idle turns do not reset either. A readied spell pays/prepares and begins held concentration at preparation; its legal target/area is selected and checked at release. The particular effect's lifetime begins only at successful release/establishment. A separately source-authorized nonspell Action repair/readied technique has its own payment at actual execution, not an invented spell cast.

NEW spell-local durations retained for authoring: Corpse Golem, Death Knight and Soul Wraith require concentration and end 60 actual seconds after establishment. Flood/Danse animation bodies end 3,600 actual seconds after their successful formation and require no concentration. Their printed Instantaneous metadata describes establishment, not a rewrite of the original. Create Undead's physical conversion is permanent; its separate rank-six authority relation and Command Undeath last until their real removal. Homunculus's created body/control is persistent with the distinct endings stated below. Soulburn and Grave Gift resolve instantaneous components and create no upkeep duration. An outside-mode six-second cycle is a clock mapping, never an extra action. Absolute deadlines, true regular owner markers, body-source expiry and already-spent command resources never reset on suppression, healing, release, renaming or mode changes.

CL10-COMMAND-01.title: Created companions, ownership and stat provenance
CL10-COMMAND-01.classification: INHERITED command/stat rules; NEW named asset caps and creation-round policies
CL10-COMMAND-01.scope: Golem, Knight, Wraith, Flood/Danse zombies, Create Undead and Homunculus only
CL10-COMMAND-01.completeText:
Keep original creator, current controller, body identity and source application as distinct records. Original creator-derived spell attacks, DCs and saves use the actual original creating class record; a temporary controller does not lend a better casting modifier. A profile that says PB as the total save bonus does not also add its ability modifier. Profile attacks add no ability damage unless that particular attack prints it. Critical hits double eligible attack dice, not flat modifiers or a later independent saving-throw aura.

The acquired Wizard Conjuration creation bonus is tested against an actual creature created by that Wizard's spell, not against the creating spell's school label alone. Snapshot its +Wizard-level maximum HP at genuine qualifying creation. The separately acquired Flesh Ascendant bonus is the current eligible controlling Wizard's +2 per Wizard level where its actual controlled-Undead predicate passes. Preserve the accepted exception that permits those two distinct bonuses together and the single strongest eligible application of each named source; no alias duplication. Later maximum-HP changes use the accepted clamp/capacity rules and do not themselves heal. If the source-owner later dies, its extant class/stat record does not become zero or a different controller's statistics.

While creator-controlled, each capable named asset resolves only in the actual attached phase after the whole owner's regular turn. A paid Bonus Action on that regular turn directs at most one eligible asset. It uses the accepted owner-wide one-command allowance and, for offense, the one-offensive-asset allowance for that numbered round across pets, minions, devices and these spells. Do not grant an independent Reaction, an extra owner turn, a second command during an extra Action or a second offensive asset because spell/class asset caps differ. The commanded asset must satisfy its own position, perception, path and resource prerequisites when it resolves. An issued command is not refunded or replayed if that phase lacks a legal action. Lack of a valid command permits only the source's actual defensive movement/Dodge, not an attack, skilled task or resource use.

NEW source limits: one Corpse Golem, one Death Knight, one Soul Wraith and one Homunculus per original caster; one Flood body; one Danse cohort containing at most five; two Create Undead authority slots. These are separate from Wizard's three standard-minion slots, Ranger Beast, Mage elite slots, Mirror assets and the existing Expedition roster. They do not multiply the shared command/offense allowances. A successful replacement ends/replaces only that spell's indicated source/body/control record. A known cap replacement must be declared before commitment; a failed new establishment never selects a substitute, but starting new concentration has already ended an incompatible prior concentration.

Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus may use a genuine still-available creation-turn Bonus Action command and subsequent real attached phase; creation itself supplies no attack/task. NEW Flood, Danse and Create Undead forbid all voluntary acts in the numbered round of creation, including a bonus Dodge; outside initiative their first possible phase is the next genuine six-second cycle. The actual source lifespan starts at formation even while this prohibition applies. Creator incapacity alone does not retroactively cancel an already valid nonconcentration order; actual concentration ending or source/body loss does. An absent original owner supplies no fictitious attached phase. Command Undeath and release of a permanent Create Undead body use CL10-ORDER-01, not an invented owner-turn refresh.

CL10-BODY-01.title: Bodies, geometry, stock and incomplete facts
CL10-BODY-01.classification: INHERITED body/gear rules; explicit scope boundaries
CL10-BODY-01.scope: Only the named authored bodies; not a world physiology or environment engine
CL10-BODY-01.completeText:
Use Tiny 2.5-by-2.5-foot, Small/Medium 5-by-5-foot and Large 10-by-10-foot occupied horizontal spaces under the accepted body rule. A source body's measured height, current orientation, actual missing parts, body mass and supports are separate facts. No named class or ordinary Small/Medium Beast gets a two-foot combat body from [1,1,1]. A new scenario must print its actual body extents; numeric damage-only examples do not prove range, cone, collision, reach or close-quarters eligibility.

A created body's initial space must already fit, be unoccupied, be perceived/targetable within the source's real range and have the source-required support before casting. No future growth or creation expands the world to legalize a target. A corpse conversion occurs at its same actual physical anchor using current matter, not a free relocation to a convenient empty square. Voluntary size changes obey actual preflight. Mandatory source ending, death, reversion, body removal and release of melded cargo always happen; no body-reservation ward or whole external-event veto is created. Where this proposal explicitly calls canonical normalization, use same anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent space in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie, with no farther search or wall/occupant passage. Normalization spends no movement and creates no opportunity/charge/movement rider. Banishment's separately named conflict semantics are not imported.

All carried/worn items are real separate IDs. Apply actual physical-capacity AND Load limits, hand/slot/fit restrictions and Burdened penalties. A listed local smaller cargo limit adds a restriction; it does not cancel weight or Load. Genuine body parcels count as bodies under their source, never bundled equipment. Created intrinsic swords/wrappings/appearance have no independent harvestable stock. On actual body ending, real gear uses current-position legal item placement, nearest legal adjacent item placement or pending-placement state. No item jumps to a distant historical last-open square, and disappearance never recreates old cargo, repairs its condition or refills fuel.

Corpse-derived animations retain one consumed physical allocation, original body history, missing limbs, harvested parts, real gear and documented physiological/terrain requirements. Their fresh listed base HP is a new animation HP pool, not limb repair, Wound treatment, resurrection or corpse replenishment. No-breath/no-food/no-water/no-sleep, immunity, natural origin and soul status cannot be inferred from the Undead/Construct label. A permanent-body work/exposure scenario must bind the actual retained needs and applicable recovery rules; an unavailable need/profile fact remains an explicit input prerequisite, not an immunity. This conference gives no global corpse-decay or living-physiology engine. The newly generated finite manifestations and Homunculus likewise gain only their stated traits; source-dependent environmental use needs the actual required trait record.

Command Undeath's required CR is an authoritative mechanical profile field, not an appearance check or a derived result from these new HP values. All four Create Undead alternatives remain unrated. The complete frozen bestiary is a source-only record collection; no exact operative CR2 Undead is supplied. A positive Command fixture therefore remains conditional until a complete individually authorized eligible profile is bound.

CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.title: Damage roots, disabled bodies and valid healing
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.classification: INHERITED root/life order plus NEW limited animation lifecycle binding
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.scope: The seven created/animated-body spells here; no universal Undead healing grant
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.completeText:
A creature attack creates its damage root at the actual accepted damage checkpoint, with that acting companion as dealer and the original creator retained separately as stat/source owner. Creator Veil does not automatically make a Golem/Knight/Wraith/zombie attack Null. Flood's ordinary spell packet has its caster as dealer. Separate attack events create separate roots; child packets inherit their parent flag; sharing preserves flags and never double-counts the parent and terminal branches. Apply the actual real damage, prevention, temporary HP, Wound/death and actual immediate-response sequence. Do not decide actual death just from reaching zero.

Qualifying Null damage uses the accepted ordered protection, including damage-caused Instant Death/Wound/Maiming/fatal-Wound exclusions and retained prior zero-state histories. It is not an HP-cost prevention, independent expiry immunity, resurrection or concentration immunity. Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus bind their existing finite-created/Construct recipient branches: a qualifying Null packet taking the surviving body to zero, or hitting the same already-disabled body, records/preserves NullDisabled0 rather than ordinary damage-caused disappearance. This adds no living-ally target predicate, Wounds, death saves, Stable roll or rest regeneration to these HP-only profiles. Their own concentration, expiry, dismissal, replacement and suppression endings still happen.

NEW named extension: Flood zombies, Danse zombies and the four Create Undead bodies use the same finite or persistent consumed-animation principle for qualifying Null damage: preserve the same body/allocation, authority, HP0, gear and clocks in NullDisabled0; no fresh corpse destruction or resource trigger. This specifically binds these new profiles and does not relabel them as Wizard standard minions. Further qualifying Null damage neither destroys nor refreshes them. Independent authority/source ending, genuine non-Null damage causing the profile's ordinary zero/destroyed branch, or another actually applicable real ending remains effective. A living target of Flood instead uses its own real living/death-save/Beast lifecycle; Null preventing its death prevents Flood's zombie claim.

Legal positive restoration to the same extant disabled body clears only that zero-HP disabled state. It never refills a command, lifespan, ability, limb or inventory. Homunculus's explicit maintenance and Wraith's own self-lifetap are named permissions. Any other proposed repair/heal must supply an actual eligible target source. A source with its own creature-only healing permission can be evaluated on its actual terms; Undead/Construct alone supplies neither immunity nor universal eligibility.

CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.title: Distinct suppression and terminal identity
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.classification: NEW source-local lifecycle choices constrained by accepted antimagic and life rules
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.scope: Only these named applications under the actual suppressing source; not a global field-size rule
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.completeText:
Do not unify the bodies merely because they are summons. A full operational body-expression suppression ends Corpse Golem, Soul Wraith and Homunculus immediately with current-position real cargo settlement and no stored return. For Golem/Wraith this also ends that now-empty creating application; it does not resume when the field ends. A narrower suppressed attack/rider suppresses only its own expression unless the actual field also suppresses the body sustaining expression.

Death Knight instead temporarily has no expressed body. Record its actual current pose when suppression starts, same identity/HP/NullDisabled state/current maximum/source owner/spent allowances and absolute deadline. Real external gear drops there under existing item placement, and intrinsic shadow equipment produces nothing. The absent body provides no occupancy, cover, support, attack or sensory presence. When all applicable suppressors end while the source remains live, attempt to re-express that same body at the saved pose using the local canonical fitting procedure. An occupied saved pose is not a protected berth. If no local placement is legal, expression remains pending within the original source lifetime; no extra duration is granted. Re-expression does not automatically reclaim dropped gear. A suppressed field can still contain the pending pose; it cannot resume merely by asking for an outside square. If source/clock ends first, nothing is re-created. A legal unsupported re-expression starts the actual Falling rules.

Flood and Danse keep their actual consumed physical bodies and real carried gear in place while their sustaining animation is suppressed. Suppressed animation supplies no voluntary movement, offense or command execution; gravity, ordinary collision/support, externally inflicted effects and absolute clocks remain real. Their eventual hour/zero/dispel/dismissal ending leaves the same consumed remains, not a fresh corpse. Create Undead is different again: permanent physical conversion is not undone by dispelling/suppressing its separate authority relation. Suppression of authority restores the body's underlying real independent agency; it does not grant an extra opportunity or free loyalty. Any independently magical native action/rider remains subject to the actual field on its own terms. Command Undeath similarly suppresses control, not an existing body's physical existence.

NEW limited geometric completion: when accepted Lesser Antimagic intersects any part of the actual expressed body of Golem, Knight, Wraith, Homunculus, Flood zombie or Danse zombie, treat that named body's sustaining expression as fully suppressed for the lifecycle above. This extends no other spell or field and grants no immunity to merely partial-body intersections. For a temporarily absent Knight test the saved expression volume. Local suppression of Create Undead/Command Undeath authority is tested at the actual bound body's volume; it changes authority, not permanent flesh. These specific choices are proposed here, not inherited globally from the two AC5 or three AC6 families. Use their actual source family exception and spell-disruption rules without editing accepted AC5/AC6.

A suppressed queued command is spent/lost at its one genuine opportunity, not banked for resumption. Source expiry, real body death/removal and mandatory form endings are never vetoed by suppression. Direct removal uses the actual class/ordinary Dispel rank/cost/check and immutable operation rules. A Wizard rank-three class Dispel is not an ordinary rank-three Dispel by name, and Greater Dispel does not replay a previously suppressed removal merely because a suppressing field was ended in the same captured operation set.

CL10-ORDER-01.title: Command Undeath and released permanent bodies
CL10-ORDER-01.classification: NEW Command-Undeath/Create-Undead-only schedule and agency completion
CL10-ORDER-01.scope: No extension of DE4 domination to other sources
CL10-ORDER-01.completeText:
Choose Q14 option B: an already independent bound creature keeps its actual pre-binding initiative position and regular opportunities. Do not migrate it to the binder's attached phase. An existing companion keeps its actual original owner's attached phase and all source-owner stats/slots. Binding, suppression, release, death of a controller and return from suppression do not create an immediate turn, refresh a used Action/Reaction, replay START/END hooks or reset a recharge. The exact actual owner or independent schedule must be bound before a current worked fixture can be claimed complete.

While Command Undeath is operative, its non-Charmed permanent restriction permits only defensive movement/Dodge without a valid command. On the binder's actual regular turn, a Bonus Action through the spell's 60-foot same-plane perceived/LoE command channel can queue one bounded order for one target's next actual future behavior opportunity. A turn already underway is not a future opportunity. The order expires at that single opportunity whether executed, suppressed, invalid, impossible or budget-starved, or at the binder's next regular START or issuance+6 actual seconds, whichever occurs first. The six-second cap is a NEW Command-Undeath-only absolute order expiry, not a new lifetime for the permanent relation. Only one pending order per binder-target exists; it cannot be banked through absence or suppression. Reaching a deadline that is also a possible execution point expires it first under the actual ordered phases. A successfully heard order does not create an ongoing remote channel: later plane separation can prevent new issue, not supply new knowledge or alter the already fixed instruction.

The issuing Bonus Action consumes the actual owner-wide command allowance of its issuance round. At execution the binder's owner-wide offensive allowance for that execution round must also be unused and is consumed once; a command that crosses a round boundary neither duplicates an offensive allowance nor refunds its prior command. For a source-owned companion, both binder's and original owner's structural allowance for that body/phase must be satisfied. Reuse an existing reservation only for the same body, same phase and same offensive opportunity; do not charge an unwilling owner a new Bonus Action or reserve another companion's attack. The absent original owner supplies no invented attached action phase. Resolve genuinely competing source-qualified directives under actual applicable ordering; this proposal does not grant authority to override another named source's explicit priority.

A valid instruction can use the body's actual movement and one ordinary Action, including a native inherent Multiattack only when the bound profile really has it. It does not force optional finite-resource powers, spellcasting, expended charges/recharges, new Bonus Actions/Reactions, secrets, prohibited oaths, item surrender or a suicide operation. Mandatory ordinary ammunition/material expenditure of an otherwise legal ordinary attack still needs the actual item; an instruction creates none. Type/obedience is not a source of private knowledge. Range and LoE for an executed attack are measured from the actual acting body, not the binder. No order changes donor or soul identity.

Suppressed Command control restores ordinary underlying agency at the same real scheduled opportunity; no instruction is performed while the control is suppressed and none replays later. When control resumes, restore the still-live relation and future defensive-only restriction without repeating its already-admitted hard-control save. Actual target death ends that relation; caster death alone does not, but a dead/absent/incapacitated binder cannot issue legal orders. The caster can release its own relation on its actual regular turn without an Action. It grants no automatic loyalty, hostility, faction membership or property ownership afterward.

For Create Undead only, losing/suppressing/replacing creator authority leaves the permanent actual body alive in its current animation state. On first independent agency, preserve that numbered round's spent opportunity and creation-round prohibition. Do not give an immediate action: place its next independent regular slot immediately after its former creator slot at that slot's next scheduled occurrence, using stable body-ID order for a group. If an old slot cannot recur because the owner has left the encounter, retain its captured virtual slot solely as a scheduling marker and assign an independent slot at the next actual encounter scheduling boundary; no retroactive turn is invented. Restoring authority retires that independent slot only prospectively into the creator's next genuinely available attached phase; at most one voluntary opportunity per round survives the transition. This is a NEW limited transition rule for these permanently created profiles, not a global controller/initiative rewrite.

Released bodies need actual NPC behavior/needs/context records before a autonomous-work/combat sequence can be claimed complete. Release is not a direction to attack, obey forever, donate HP, take a crew job or harvest another corpse. Two authority slots are not a world population cap. Repeated genuinely paid Create Undead casts with different eligible real corpses may accumulate independent bodies over time; no automatic service, material reward or free roster space follows.

Outside initiative, a released permanent body uses independent successive six-second opportunities beginning no earlier than its next unspent former cycle boundary; re-entering initiative maps that pending opportunity without replay or refresh. This defines timing only. It supplies no unreviewed NPC goal, ability, reaction budget, physiology or work permission.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: All five preserve Action/120feet/V,S,F/rank8/base21RP and native class access. Water Pet, Archlich Shade and Faction Paragon print concentration minute; both fortresses print Instantaneous, while Shifting Fortress expressly lasts5rounds.
options: Reuse ordinary casting and source-qualified current interfaces; explicitly complete only the missing per-spell fields.
Identify a specific source contradiction before changing any settled contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep original current sources, schools, levels and access. No external monster/siege block or real-world physics shortcut supplies missing native mechanics. A spell title grants no extra building, class, creature type, body immunity or resources.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Printed HP90 and AC16 do not define size, mass, speed, senses, other stats or swimming.
options: NEW Medium finite Elemental body using an explicitly enumerated profile; retain90baseHP/16baseAC, actual owner-class stat provenance and shared companion command. Propose walk30/swim40,150lb and a complete stated anatomy/ability record.
Use the lower Water Pet profile with only the printed HP/AC/heal/attack changes, adding no swim or fluid-body capability.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Either needs exact concurrence; first adds new native mobility, second is narrower. Do not infer water breathing, squeezing, resistance, hands, passenger support or material water. Define actual creation-space fit and creation-round command opportunity; no free arrival Action.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Healing wave3d6 AoE OR2d10 cold blast supplies no geometry, range, target filter or accuracy.
options: NEW heal one shared3d6 pool to willing actual eligible allies intersecting a10foot-radius sphere centered on the pet with body-interior/LoE witnesses; blast one ranged60foot spell attack for2d10cold. Each option consumes the one owner-wide offensive/support allowance and actual command.
Choose a different fully specified finite heal shape/radius and cold attack/save model, preserving AoE healing and their alternative use.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer the first as explicit source-scoped geometry. Apply actual per-recipient healing modifiers and full/zeroHP eligibility independently; no overheal pool, duplicate recipient or unlimited pulses. Resolve self-healing and mechanical living-ally extension explicitly; no generic admission follows from a name.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Lower Water Pet deliberately spends the shared offense/support allowance on healing and has a specific NullDisabled/healing/suppression interface.
options: Explicitly extend those narrow command/Null/healing permissions to this new pet, with one greater pet per caster and unchanged source minute, real maximumHP modifiers, damage ownership and cargo conservation.
Give a distinct healing/ending rule with exact reasons; do not silently create a second round allowance.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer explicit extension. Pet owns its heal/attack; owner class hooks do not automatically fire. Suppression retains body/HP/deadline but cannot replay missed commands or heals. Ordinary0 ends the finite body; qualifying Null0 stays the same disabled body only under the approved extension.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: HP160, casts necrotic spells and drains enemies supplies no full body/profile or acquisition of a real lich.
options: NEW one bounded Medium shade with fully specified AC, ability scores, mass, speeds, senses and exact source-owner statistics;160baseHP and the actual concentration minute.
Use an actual complete documented existing creature profile if it preserves the source promises, with every difference explicitly reconciled.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer a finite newly authored summon profile; no phylactery, actual dead person, soul ownership, elite asset identity, immunity, hover or CR follows from Archlich. Explicitly state appearance versus physical body interactions and required body organs/outlets.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Casts necrotic spells requires real spell activations, not a renamed generic2d8 attack; no repertoire or RP pool is given.
options: NEW grant a finite named repertoire drawn from actual reviewed necrotic spells, with the owner funding each real spell cost and one actual command/offense opportunity; define actor/source, component legality, payment, countering and cadence explicitly.

Give the shade a finite creation-snapshot spell budget/charges, supply every selected spell and recharge endpoint, and demonstrate that recasting pays the actual summon cost rather than resetting free world resources.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: The choice is consequential. Proposed repertoire candidates Chill Touch, Vampiric Touch and Enervation must retain their actual full procedures and dependencies; other picks need exact source support. Decide cost modification, metamagic/acquisition, Dissonance/Refrain ownership and damage/kill hooks rather than granting the owner every repertoire spell.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A parent concentration spell and possible child concentration spells need separate owners and precise action scheduling.
options: Shade may own at most one independently paid child concentration source; owner retains parent concentration. Every cast uses an actual attached command/offense opportunity, with no separate free turn or mirrored owner action. Ending the shade ends its child concentration.
Limit the selected repertoire to nonconcentration spells and separately specify a native drain Action; retain multiple true necrotic spells.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer the first only with explicit engine ownership and legal component bodies. Starting a child spell cannot accidentally terminate the owner parent or create a second owner concentration. Define channeled follow-up Actions, reaction availability, counterspells, suppression and no orphaned recurring payload.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Drains enemies does not state quantity or whether HP, maximumHP or RP is gained.
options: NEW one native melee5foot necrotic drain attack with an exact damage pool, healing the shade for floor(actual normalHP loss/2), capped by its actual healing limits; no owner healing, maxHP theft or RP.
Attach a bounded drain rider to qualifying shade spells, specifying which target/event supplies recovery and a once-per-round cap to avoid multiplying an AoE.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require exact damage and victim predicate. Use actual positive normalHP loss after all defenses/tempHP, not nominal damage, overkill or a friendly fabricated battery. Explain enemy selection without assigning new faction truth; ordinary healing prohibition and no copy/resource recursion remain actual. No class Life Drain package is imported.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Summon THE CHAMPION OF YOUR ALLIED FACTION may indicate a real identity; lower Faction Champion expressly creates a bounded representative.
options: NEW use a temporary representative of the actual faction champion with a complete finite profile and no borrowed private identity, inventory, authority or secret knowledge.
Transport the actual willing documented champion, requiring its real availability/consent/profile and a specified legal local/planar route without duplication.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not silently inherit the lower spell interpretation. Prefer the representative only if GPT expressly agrees it preserves this rank8 source; otherwise retain real-person content/transport holds. Neither option creates a faction, named champion or cosmology.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Allied faction and champion selection need actual institutional predicates rather than alignment or positive standing alone.
options: Explicitly extend actual AC5 alliedStatus+standing>0+invocationPermission+no-aid-prohibition gate; use one known factionId and declared eligible champion/profile before payment.
Supply a different exact rank8 faction entitlement with evidence and preserve hidden availability/consent checks.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer scoped reuse of the actual institutional gate. Standing alone, membership or class allegiance is insufficient. State whether a later aid prohibition affects an established manifestation; no automatic official title, negotiation power, reputation gain or remote faction information.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No paragon HP/AC/actions or returned-person consequences are printed.
options: For a representative, author one complete source-native rank8 profile, its finite actions and shared companion limits, real concentration minute and narrow Null/healing/suppression bindings.

For the actual-person branch, retain its actual HP/resources/gear/agency/initiative and exactly one body; decide voluntary commanded assistance, arrival/return and every persistent injury/death consequence.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Complete the chosen branch in full. Do not copy an unknown NPC sheet or give it both its own full turn and an attached companion turn. Created intrinsic gear is not loot; real borrowed gear remains real. Missing exact champion/profile content keeps relevant cases held.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Printed benefit is a floating PLATFORM for high ground or ranged cover, not a whole weaponized settlement; dimensions, elevation, access and lifetime are absent.
options: NEW one finite horizontal platform with explicit solid geometry, rail/cover form, anchor/elevation within120feet, finite capacity and60second concentration lifetime.
Choose a different explicit size/lifetime and nonconcentration form while supplying complete support, destruction and removal rules.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer a fully specified bounded platform; GPT must select exact dimensions, capacity,HP/AC/material response and safe access. Casting range is not automatic permissible elevation through obstructions. Initial solid volume must fit actual space without spawning through bodies or lifting them for free.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: High ground or ranged cover must have a native mechanical meaning, while existing cover is actual line geometry with best+2/+5 only.
options: Platform provides actual elevation and explicit half-cover parapets; use actual lines, facing and core cover. Any additional high-ground attack benefit must be separately authored.
Choose mutually exclusive deployment forms: open raised platform or fixed ranged-cover canopy, each with explicit geometry and any source-local bonus.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer real elevation/cover rather than automatic advantage or total protection. Preserve the printed useful high-ground option without inventing a universal height-to-hit rule. State ally/enemy access, attack origin and body/cover intersections.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Floating does not print travel speed or piloting; occupants/cargo cannot be erased when the source ends.
options: Keep the platform spatially fixed after establishment; active magic supplies support only. On suppression/destruction/expiry the structure ends or loses support according to an explicit chosen source profile; real occupants/cargo use actual Falling at their current locations.
Permit bounded commanded travel with explicit speed, operator cost, collision, load and arrival geometry as NEW additional function.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer fixed support unless travel is expressly chosen. State overload and resumption without gratuitous crushing, free descent, teleportation, recreated cargo or salvage. The selected disappearance-versus-suppressed-body behavior must be consistent throughout the full casebook.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Mobile stone BUILDING WITH SIEGE WEAPONS lasts5ROUNDS; dimensions, armor, structuralHP, rooms, load and weapon count are missing.
options: NEW one complete finite building chassis with explicit occupied solid/interior volumes, entrances, capacity, AC/HP and two fixed siege emplacements; keep source5round lifetime with no extra concentration unless explicitly chosen.
Select another full finite chassis/weapon count and concentration policy, preserving both useful mobility and siege capability.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: GPT must author the actual numeric profile and body/material permissions. Do not turn this into a decorative platform or import an external castle/ballista block. Five rounds should bind the existing source-future-START convention or an expressly reconciled real-time clock, not silently become a minute.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Building mobility lacks a controller, action cost, route restrictions or collision authority.
options: NEW one authorized operator spends an actual Action to move it up to a fixed walking Speed along a fully legal swept volume, at most once per original owner regular opportunity; it supports real occupants/cargo.
Use the creator Bonus Action to order one attached structural movement, explicitly deciding whether it shares any companion command ledger.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose one actual budget. The structure has no independent creature turn, free Dash, teleport, flight, forced overlap or automatic ram damage. Supply slope/step/support constraints and distinguish moving the platform beneath occupants from granting each occupant extra voluntary movement.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Siege weapons need complete native damage/range/accuracy, loading/firing, operators and ammunition histories.
options: NEW finite manifest siege projectiles inseparable from this source, one explicit load/aim/fire sequence per actual emplacement and real operator Actions; projectiles vanish on resolution/expiry and create no harvest stock.
Require real compatible external ammunition and actual documented weapon profiles, with each loading/firing Action and remaining item preserved.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select one complete weapon menu with exact ranges, damage types, attack/save formula, target predicates, LoE and structural damage permissions. Multiple weapons need multiple real operator budgets; no automatic simultaneous volley or cloned ammunition. Intrinsic ammunition may not become transferable inventory.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Five-round expiry, structural0, suppression and occupants at elevation need one coherent ending process.
options: Use source-owned five future regular STARTs, excluding the casting START; source removal does not reschedule them and outside initiative use30elapsedseconds. Ending releases real occupants and external cargo at their actual positions to ordinary support/Falling; no teleport or invented crushing.
Choose an explicit absolute30second field lifetime if required by the current clock contract, preserving the printed5round intent and explaining the difference.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer existing buff-clock binding where applicable. State partial structural damage, destroyed supports/weapon bays, collision failures, overload and suppressed-object persistence. Same-caster recast cannot heal damaged external cargo, replenish real ammunition or duplicate occupants; a new paid structure must still pass actual placement.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Creature and structure origin, caster/controller and damage/healing ownership differ; current accepted analogues are tightly scoped.
options: Explicitly route each new creature native Action/spell, structural weapon and stored source through its actual creating actor and Null lifecycle. Reuse exact source-qualified recipient permissions only by named extension.
Identify a concrete contradictory source before extending an existing root/cap/suppression contract globally.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: One spell-created body is not automatically the caster for every damage/kill/heal hook. Structural weapons must identify actual operator/dealer; no automatic pet Null status or creature healing on an object. Never convert structure destruction into XP, corpse, resource or material income without a real source.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No complete prior procedures/cases exist for these five. Named missing profiles and operator/body geometry must remain explicit dependencies.
options: After choices author at least two complete deterministic cases per spell plus branches for every new consequential decision, with actual provider/repertoire/RP, geometry, clocks, commands/operators and final conserved state.
Keep unsupported champion/rating/profile/structural geometry cases held, without inventing the missing fact or reporting conditional arithmetic as runtime execution.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use both as needed. Include Water heal/attack alternatives and caps, Shade paid child casting/drain/parent ending, faction hidden gates and actual identity policy, platform access/cover/fall, fortress mixed operator budgets/swept collision/five-round expiry and complete real-cargo conservation.

sourceCandidateUnchanged.nonAcceptanceOfLaterSourceChanges: Current source files in this packet are bound current context only. If a local source or procedure differs from a historical accepted snapshot or receipt, that difference does not expand accepted scope. Use recorded acceptance/application receipts as the limit; do not reopen accepted identities.

common.scope: NEW spell-local operational authorship only. Native source envelopes are immutable; they still say blocked-pending-operational-review and operational=null. The isolated proposal is not installed in the live catalog. Exact accepted interfaces are reproduced in ORIGINAL_SOURCE_RECORDS.json; no later backing-file changes become accepted merely by presence.
common.access: Use the native classAccess rows exactly, actual class level, actual known/book/prepared entry, class prerequisites and available rank. Rank8 costs21RP before actual source-specific adjustments; no Overcast, invented acquisition, global discounts, slots or imported costly components. V/S/F, ordinary Action, one perceived target or declared target set within120ft and unobstructed line of effect at commitment and application. A focus is an actual accessible item; no material cost is added. Missing access or known physical illegality prevents commitment. Hidden disqualification after a lawful commitment spends the cast without an oracle or substitute target.
common.commitment: Resolve actual current defenses, legal ability to act, anatomy/components and perception before committing. Spend Action and actual21RP; record exact family, base strain, Refrain, Dissonance and any source-specific hooks. Wizard first prepared family in encounter has0 base strain; rank8 repeated family uses base2 plus actual Refrain. Other ordinary classes use rank8 base2 plus Refrain. Read Dissonance before casting: limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); ranked surcharge at limit/limit+3/limit+6 is+1/+2/+3RP, and ordinary rank1+ casting is blocked at limit+6 absent an actual expressly granted traumatic exception. Refrain for consecutive same-name casts is+1/+2/+3 capped3; a different name resets it to0, idle/weapon turns do not. Track all actual threshold consequences if reached. Nondamaging Life/Form spells are not damaging Mage Focus casts: clear Nuke Chain; no Surge damage or chain award. Animal Shapes is not Druid Shapeshift and clears no Refrain or reserves.
common.timing: Use elapsed seconds plus original regular-slot marker and phase. Absolute expiry at phase0 wins before new events at that timestamp. Complete an already resolving packet under its actual source ordering; no extra turns tick clocks. Ready uses its own actual Action commitment, components,21RP/strain and concentration hold, then one eligible Reaction release before its deadline; it gives no free cast or renewed duration. Ready selects the legal target set/area and any required body/form/anchor choices at release, not at preparation, as the accepted Ready exception. Revalidate every prerequisite and all-outcome fit before spending the release Reaction; invalid/declined occurrence may await another valid trigger until next regular own-turn START, with setup cost retained. Counterspell is at preparation only. Effect duration/maturity starts at successful release/application, not preparation. For Animal Shapes a concentration hold becomes the shared effect on successful release; loss/failure does not restore prior concentration. Other effects end the Ready hold after resolution.
common.defenses: Use actual acquired Counterspell, reflection, immunity, antimagic, dispel and concentration records within exact scope, not spell names or guessed ranks. All four are rank8 for applicable checks. A class Wizard Dispel is rank3 at its printed3RP/check10+target rank; it is never Greater Dispel rank5. Source-specific counter success is necessary; a suppressed effect is not terminated unless its source says so. New Animal concentration ends old same-caster concentration at commitment, before counter/save/failure. Nonconcentration Clone/Flesh/Perfect do not end other concentration unless Ready does.
common.returnsAndOwnership: Preserve actors, real body and item IDs, personal HP/max ledger, temporaryHP, Wounds/injuries, actual conditions, paid resources, spent turn markers, debts, death and return histories. Do not infer ownership, loyalty, soul geography, CR, content permission, creature roster or preparation from a title. Actual death ends concentration and only the effects whose sources end on death; completed memory losses and other persistent personal consequences are retained. Every fixture is synthetic data for a static rule trace, not an acquired campaign character or physical-world proof.
common.holds: Source/access/content/form/body geometry/identity topology/runtime/human-play/balance/release holds survive this return. A missing prerequisite holds the whole dependent case or branch; it cannot be narrated as a positive actual campaign result. All changed rules below are NEW only for these four spells.

rules.selection: NEW for an ordinary cast select1–10 distinct willing perceived physical creature-origin recipients and one of the seven complete animal mappings per recipient before commitment. The common accepted Ready exception instead selects this set at release after paid preparation; fit is then checked before the release Reaction. No mass opt-in later, arbitrary bestiary, CR filtering, hidden target replacement or switching forms during the effect. Form names denote actual chosen spell-local beast anatomy, not a change of origin taxonomy. Object-origin transformed objects, summon bodies with incompatible lifecycle, unknown anatomy/mass and undocumented origin require their own established source; otherwise that dependent branch is held. Actual willing withdrawal before resolution makes only that recipient fail, with cost retained.
rules.duration: NEW one shared rank8 concentration record expires exactly60elapsedseconds after successful application; individual target links may end separately. Caster concentration loss/death ends all links; ending the final target link ends this now-empty shared concentration. Range120 is acquisition/application only, not a maintained tether. No extra body, turn, HP pool, concentration slot or form-switch Action is granted.
rules.geometry: NEW reuse accepted all-outcome fit: before ordinary payment (or before an already-paid Ready release Reaction) every target origin O and proposed transformed T must fit simultaneously for every pair O/O,O/T,T/O,T/T, other creatures, occupied matter and height. Reproject roots when this caster must drop an earlier concentration. Recheck at resolution; hidden newly blocked recipient fails, no displacement of another actor. Mandatory reversion ends the form even if placement becomes difficult: source-scoped BODY same anchor, actual legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie; no farther search or barrier crossing. If none, record placementConflict and hold geometry-dependent continuation. Banishment-specific conflict rules are not globalized.
rules.identityAndGear: NEW explicitly reuse accepted creature transformation conservation. Scores, PB, HP/max/tempHP, class resources, Wounds, injuries, identity, species/ancestry, conditions and initiative remain real. Only listed anatomy/movement/AC/natural attack changes. Base body weight unchanged even across sizes; actual cargo still weighs including melded items; BODY carry/load and actual anatomy restrictions apply. Earliest root carried gear becomes melded, inaccessible, custody unchanged; incompatible armor/features cease expression. Existing external cargo stays external. Successful legal replacement closes previous anatomy atomically and recaptures actual extant gear once, never restores consumed items, charges or healing. No displaced form stack. Druid class Shapeshift cannot enter while a spell-form record remains, including suppressed.
rules.attacks: NEW use current original caster attack bonus/M for the mapped natural attack; original caster statistics must be actually resolvable. Subject is the attacker/damage owner for Null, kill credit and reactions; no caster cast-proc on a natural attack. One attack per ordinary Attack Action, reach5, listed dice+M; no Multiattack, spells, magic attacks, class beast benefits or senses beyond mapped/existing compatible source. Missing caster-stat provenance holds the attack branch; other links do not disappear.

rules.conservation: Return relocates the one personal identity into the actual clone body; physical old remains and their actual gear persist at their old positions but all other remains lose duplicate-return eligibility.
